name: granttrail-ai
description: GrantTrail AI — Subaward Reporting Assistant for Riverbend Housing Coalition (fictional). AI extracts. Code validates. Humans approve.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit
